newsitem.title: RUSSIA: WEIGHTLIFTING-BATTLE LOOMS FOR CONTROL OF RUSSIAN LIFTERS.
newsitem.headline: WEIGHTLIFTING-BATTLE LOOMS FOR CONTROL OF RUSSIAN LIFTERS.

text.p: A battle loomed for control of Russia's weightlifting federation on Tuesday after a Moscow court ruled that former federation chief Viktor Polyakov was wrongly dismissed.
The court ruled on Monday that Viktor Polyakov had been unfairly forced out in a power struggle in 1994 after 25 years as head of the federation.
"Justice has triumphed," said Polkyakov after a three-year legal battle. "I will take up my job as president of the weightlifting federation president of Russia."
But Israil Arsamakov, who is now the federation's president, said he planned to stay on.
"There are many things for me to finish and I recently received 50 letters of support from the provinces in my support," he said.
It was not immediately clear how the dispute would be resolved and if further legal battles lay ahead.
